author: Good Enough
description:
He found the gold that started the California Gold Rush, but died a poor man.

After discovering gold at Sutter’s Mill, James W. Marshall helped trigger one of the biggest rushes in American history. But instead of becoming rich, he spent the rest of his life chasing gold himself and never truly profited from the discovery that changed everything.

This Short tells the tragic story of the man who found gold first… and still ended up with nothing.
title: He Found Gold... But Died Poor 🥇😞 #didyouknow #history #americanhistory #darkhistory #facts
